about: Triggering + behavior evals (A9). propose-components PLANS which sections/blocks become components (produces the confirmed inventory); it builds nothing in Figma.

cases.prompt: decide which sections and blocks should become Figma components
plan the component inventory and their variants
which sections are worth turning into components?
now actually build the confirmed components in Figma

behaviorCases.after: user confirms both Phase A and Phase B
behaviorCases.assert: manifest components.status === 'confirmed' AND components.summary is written with atoms/universalBlocks/sections counts

behaviorCases.after: a section is selected with two tier-1 variant settings of 3 and 2 values
